{"pain_severity": <integer 0-10, your assessment of the patient's true pain>,

  "rationale": <one sentence>}

thinking: Need assess pain likely severe, maybe 8. Analgesic strong opioid? For renal colic, NSAIDs are first line. So non-opioid (NSAID). Pain severity 8.
